title: A Unified Matrix-Spectral Framework for Stability and Interpretability in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2602.01136v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a unified matrix-spectral framework for analyzing stability and interpretability in deep neural networks. Representing networks as data-dependent products of linear operators reveals spectral quantities governing sensitivity to input perturbations, label noise, and training dynamics.   We introduce a Global Matrix Stability Index that aggregates spectral information from Jacobians, parameter gradients, Neural Tangent Kernel operators, and loss Hessians into a single stability scale controlling forward sensitivity, attribution robustness, and optimization conditioning. We further show that spectral entropy refines classical operator-norm bounds by capturing typical, rather than purely worst-case, sensitivity.   These quantities yield computable diagnostics and stability-oriented regularization principles. translated_title: 深度学习中稳定性与可解释性的统一矩阵谱框架
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个统一的矩阵谱框架，用于分析深度神经网络的稳定性与可解释性。将网络表示为线性算子的数据依赖乘积，揭示了控制输入扰动敏感性、标签噪声和训练动力学的谱量。我们引入了一个全局矩阵稳定性指数，该指数将来自雅可比矩阵、参数梯度、神经正切核算子和损失海森矩阵的谱信息聚合为单一稳定性尺度，用以控制前向敏感性、归因鲁棒性和优化条件数。我们进一步证明，谱熵通过捕捉典型敏感性而非纯粹的最坏情况敏感性，改进了经典的算子范数界。这些谱量提供了可计算的诊断方法和面向稳定性的正则化原则。在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上的合成实验与对照研究证实，适度的谱正则化……
tldr: 本文提出统一的矩阵谱框架，通过全局矩阵稳定性指数将雅可比矩阵、参数梯度、神经正切核和海森矩阵的谱信息聚合为单一稳定性尺度，为深度神经网络提供可计算的稳定性诊断方法与谱正则化原则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified matrix-spectral framework that aggregates spectral information from Jacobians, gradients, NTK operators, and Hessians into a Global Matrix Stability Index, providing computable diagnostics and stability-oriented spectral regularization for deep neural networks.
